entrySummary: 메시지가 무엇을 요구하는지, 독립적인 공개 출처가 무엇을 확인할 수 있는지, 다음에 어디서 확인해야 하는지 살펴보세요.
uploadHint: 여기에 놓거나 파일 선택 · PDF, PNG, JPG · 최대 16 MB
privacyNote: 원본 파일은 이 기기에 남습니다. 추출된 텍스트는 확인을 위해 전송될 수 있습니다.
translatedNote: 표시 언어로 번역되었습니다. 출처 인용문은 원래 문구를 유지합니다.
publicSourcesNote: 각 항목은 발급 법원 또는 기관으로 연결됩니다.
translationUnavailable: 결과 번역을 지금 사용할 수 없습니다. 원문과 증거는 변경되지 않습니다.
receiveHint: Upload the message or paste it exactly as you received it.
extractedSent: Extracted text may be sent for checking
noUploadNeeded: No upload needed. Each example is synthetic.
examplesDisclaimer: Examples use fictional personal details and published scam patterns.
readingLocal: Reading locally before any text is checked.
keepTabOpen: Keep this tab open while this check finishes.
filePrivacy: The original file stays in this browser. Only extracted text is sent for claim structuring.
pastePrivacy: Pasted text can be sent for claim structuring; SEAL does not store it.
openServiceNote: Opens an independently sourced official service.
evidenceRecordHint: Claims, source provenance, and technical details
inspectEachDetail: Inspect each extracted detail and the source evidence available for it.
nextHelpCopy: Keep the message, but use a court site or support service you opened yourself for anything you do next.
notLegalAdvice: This explains what SEAL extracted and verified. It is not legal advice.
noLegalAidDirectory: No reviewed legal-aid directory is linked for this jurisdiction yet.
courtContactOfficial: Court contact from an official source
onboardingUploadCopy: Upload a screenshot or PDF, or paste the text. SEAL reads the message before it checks anything else.
courtsNoDemand: Courts do not demand payment this way.
realCourtNameNotEnough: A real court name is not enough.
onboardingEvidenceCopy: SEAL separates what the message asks you to do from official-looking details, then checks only what public sources can establish.
onboardingResultCopy: SEAL does not authenticate a message just because some details match. It shows what is confirmed, what is not, and where to verify safely.
seeRealCourtMessages: See what real court messages look like
browseDeck: Browse notices and scam warnings published by courts and public agencies. Open the original source, or check an example in SEAL.
browseScope: If a detail cannot be independently confirmed, SEAL leaves it unconfirmed.
courtLiveFailed: The court’s live pages didn’t respond. Affected claims remain unverified.
independentToolNote: Independent tool · Not affiliated with any court.
claimsFederalCourt: Claims to be a federal court
exampleNoticeDisclaimer: This example uses fictional personal details. SEAL is not affiliated with any court.
checkCourtDirectly: Check this with the court directly.
noCourtDetails: No court or case details could be read reliably.
